candidate_program.name: bounded_conflict_pivot
candidate_program.rationale: Adds bounded conflict-density and conflict-mass bonuses to reward, then penalizes the strongest rival. Reach includes residual summaries; arithmetic is constant cost, but aggregate updates remain charged and centrality can trade against greedy inclusion quality.
candidate_program.rule: weight * (1 + 0.5 * degree / max(1, remaining_count - 1) + 0.5 * conflict_weight / (1 + weight + conflict_weight + compatible_weight)) - 0.25 * max_conflict_weight

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
cost_scope: Cached offline score-fit evaluation only; does not replace complete-schedule charged cost
